messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 latency crossed 800ms (SLO burn) for route /v1/generate on hosted-api-prod us-west-1. PagerDuty PD-4567 fired.

alex: acked PD-4567, I'm taking first-touch.

priya: oncall handoff in 10m but can start triage now. any obvious deploys?

kyle: checking autoscaler + GPU pool metrics. seeing CPU and GPU utilization spike on pool-gpu-02, queue length up ~3x.

sam: routing histogram shows tail at ~950ms p99, p95 ~420ms. few 10s spikes from kv-cache misses.

ops-bot: automatic fallback rule engaged: routing some traffic to model-quantized-small in eu-west to shed load. 12% of traffic rerouted.

priya: can we temporarily increase dedicated slice for hosted-api-prod? request sent to infra autoscaler: runbook->scale pool-gpu-02 +2 replicas.

alex: doing a cold warmup for kv cache keys for top 50 prefixes. running: ```./scripts/warm_kv.sh --prefix-file top-prefixes.txt --target pool-gpu-02```

kyle: autoscaler accepted scale, new replicas requested. watching node spin-up. also bumping max-batcher window to 50ms to increase throughput (will trade some latency). command: ```kubectl patch hpa hosted-api-prod -p '{"spec":{"maxReplicas":12}}'```

sam: note: raising batch window might increase p95 a bit, but should reduce p99 tail after KV warm.

support-lead: heads-up to CS: small spike in latencies may be visible for some customers but no error rate increase. drafting short status note.

alex: confirming cold starts finishing, new pods joining pool-gpu-02. KV warm script at 60% complete.

incident-bot: Update: PD-4567 acknowledged by alex. Escalation to SEV2 if p99 > 1s for next 10m.

kyle: telemetry shows p99 trending down to 620ms after reroute + warmup. queue length dropping.

priya: will keep monitoring through handoff. if stable for 15m we can start de-escalation.

sam: leaving a quick note for postmortem: consider proactive KV pre-warm during US evening traffic and revisit batcher defaults for long-tail workloads.

alex: +1. tagging for follow-up: #eng-runtime and #eng-ml. I'm handing off to priya at 1764130500.

priya: taking over. continuing to monitor; posting updates in incident tracker PD-4567. :thumbsup:
